observed_source_facts: DuplexSLA uses a shared 160 ms conversational chunk clock with continuous user audio, assistant audio, and a separate rate-limited textual action channel.
The action channel can carry delayed transcript text, planning text, interaction-control labels and structured tool calls while assistant audio continues.
The paper evaluates pause, interruption, backchannel behavior and in-conversation tool calling together.

The pinned upstream repository currently contains README.md, LICENSE, DuplexSLA.pdf, .gitignore and assets only; no inference implementation, released checkpoint, deployment recipe or benchmark code is present at the pinned commit.
The public project README describes the backbone as Step-Audio-2-mini at approximately 7B parameters.

The currently published Step-Audio-2-mini model metadata identifies English and Chinese; no German language support claim was found in the DuplexSLA paper/repository evidence inspected for this audit.

Step-Audio-2-mini public local usage is CUDA-oriented and its published artifact is approximately 17.9 GB; this is upstream context only and does not establish DuplexSLA target-runtime fit on clay-direct-dev.

reasons: No released DuplexSLA model/inference artifacts exist at the pinned source identity, so V2 LOCAL_RUNNABLE_COMPONENT cannot be established.
